label: sec:piand
title: Parametric Integer And
html:
The term &N(k,x,y) denotes the parametric integer and of x and y viewed as bit-vectors of width k. Its sub-solver follows the same scheme as the exp-solver.

Table 7 lists the new lemmas of the &N-solver. They extend the lemmas of [7, Table 4], which we keep and do not repeat here. The central one is complement: (⟨x⟩k​∧⟨y⟩k​)⇒&N(k,x,y)+&N(k,x,∼y)≈x. Every bit of x is set in exactly one of y and its complement ∼y, so the parametric integer ands of x with y and with ∼y partition the bits of x. This lemma is useful because it connects two &N-instances by a linear constraint, which the arithmetic solver can then use directly, without expanding either instance into its bits.
